tools.name: get_host_info
tools.title: Get Host Info
tools.description: Return host metadata, supported infrastructure operations, and where this Host Agent itself is installed. The agent block answers "where are you, so I can put something next to you?" -- home directory, systemd scope and unit directory, the agent's own environment file, and the loopback MCP endpoint a co-located provider calls back on -- so a recipe can place a provider beside the agent without being told any of it.

agent.description: Where this Host Agent is installed. A recipe places a provider module beside the agent by interpolating these, so they are typed rather than opaque. Fields are omitted when the agent cannot observe them; environmentFile appears only when the file is actually present.

environmentFile.description: The agent's own environment file, carrying the credential a co-located provider calls back with. Suitable for a unit's EnvironmentFile=.

mcpEndpoint.description: Loopback MCP endpoint a provider running on this same host dials back on. Not the agent's public or bridge address.

serviceScope.description: Which systemd manager owns units this agent installs. Root under the system manager owns /etc/systemd/system; anyone else owns their own user manager and cannot write there.

serviceWantedBy.description: The target a unit in this scope should be WantedBy=. The user manager has no multi-user.target, so the pairing is reported rather than guessed.

capacity.description: Declared Incus resource allocations and current VM/container mix on this host.

rootDiskQuota.description: Whether the storage pool a new instance lands on can enforce a requested root disk size. Provisioning refuses an unenforceable explicit size.

system.description: Effective host/cgroup resource limits, usage, load, and memory pressure.
